cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen as G
reqs=[G.gen(31000+i) for i in range(400)]
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
print("planner time", time.time()-t0)
# per-instance: rerun individually for the slowest
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
import numpy as np
sizes=[(len(r['edges']), sum(len(c['paths']) for c in r['commodities']), len(r['commodities'])) for r in reqs]
idx=np.argsort([-s[0]*s[1] for s in sizes])[:5]
for i in idx:
    t0=time.time()
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=json.dumps(reqs[i]).encode()+b"\n",capture_output=True)
    print(i, sizes[i], "one-shot %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), lines[i][:60])
PYEOF
